title: Frameless laminated glass balustrade (Governors Bay, Christchurch)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: NZ Building Code as cited (B1, F2, F4)
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Frameless cantilevered glass balustrade with laminated toughened-glass panels (two panes with a plastic interlayer), installed on a house; installer included as a person with an interest.
Matter: whether the balustrade as installed complied with B1.3.1, B1.3.4(a), B2.3.1, F2.3.3(a), F4.3.4(c) and (d); post-breakage behaviour is used only as information about the installed balustrade.
Ministry-commissioned independent expert report (§4); producer statements and acceptable-solution and verification-method references discussed in §6.
Decision (16 April 2021): as installed, complied with F2.3.3(a) but did not comply with B1.3.1, B1.3.4(a), F4.3.4(c) and (d).
